name: closed_w_items
design: requested arm (direct_answer) of the main panel, every template of the four benchmarks, the same 100 items per benchmark; one call per (template, item) per model
item_rule: nested seeded permutations of the sorted item ids, numpy.random.default_rng(src.decision.label_seed('closed_w/b/<task>')), the first 100; BIG-Bench Hard per task, label 'closed_w/b/bbh/<task>', the first 4 of each of 25 tasks (scripts/closed_w_items.sample_items, Design B100)
request_list_rule: per benchmark, the rows of the source file with arm direct_answer, an item of `items` and a template of `templates` (every pair present once); requests_sha256 is the sha256 of the sorted lines 'request_id<TAB>sha256(user message, UTF-8)' joined by newlines

pilot.rule: per benchmark 5 rows of the request list in sha256 order of ('closed_w/pilot', benchmark, template, item), with distinct templates, items and BIG-Bench Hard tasks; on HotpotQA the longest request (UTF-8 bytes) first

prefill.rule: per benchmark 10 calibration rows (training split; data/requests/<task>/screening/qwen3-8b.parquet, direct_answer) under a run template, in sha256 order of ('closed_w/prefill', benchmark, template, item), with distinct templates, items and BIG-Bench Hard tasks

control.rule: the MATH Level 5 calibration item (data/processed/math/items_screening.parquet) under a run template, first in sha256 order of ('closed_w/control', 'math', template, item); its direct_answer prompt is sent with thinking on

matches_closed_w_price: Design B100 of results/frontier_panel/closed_w_price.json: calls and templates per benchmark

arms.rule: per arm and benchmark, the rows of the arm's request files (config `requests`) with the arm's source label, an item of tasks.<benchmark>.items and a template of tasks.<benchmark>.templates (every pair present once); requests_sha256 as tasks.<benchmark>.requests_sha256. The pilot rows of every arm are the cells of pilot.rows (the requested arm's pilot); the stop control re-sends the forced pilot rows of the benchmarks whose forced stop is sent, without the stop.

stop_control.rows: pilot.forced.<benchmark>, sent once more without the stop
